correctness.rationale: Conjugation and third-iterate elimination are explicit. The integral identity produces U^2(U^6-3U^2+6), with u=±1 excluded. The cubic J(Z)=Z^3-3Z+6 is Eisenstein at three with nonsquare discriminant -864; the sextic is Eisenstein at three, factors over Q(sqrt(-6)) into a cubic with square discriminant 36 and its negated conjugate; hence the sextic splitting field equals the S3 splitting field of J and the root action is regular. For p>=5 unramified Frobenius either fixes all six roots or none. Chebotarev assigns densities 1/6,1/2,1/3. Characteristic three is handled directly. The standalone verification independently checks polynomial identities and finite-field instances.

value.rationale: The motivating map is a canonical explicit quadratic permutation in a recent finite-field paper. Its primitive three-cycle occurrence has a nontrivial all-or-none arithmetic splitting rule for every odd prime power, a complete minimal-extension trichotomy and exact natural prime densities. This is more informative than an arbitrary coefficient test and connects the permutation functional graph to its degree-six S3 splitting field. Higher cycles and effective prime bounds are outside scope.
